en.description: Every pattern at once, in two languages: landing, Google sign-in, dashboard, records grid and an interactive map.

landing.headline: Know where every vehicle is
landing.subheadline: Register your routes once and see them on a map your whole team shares.

features.title: Routes on a map
features.description: See every registered route without opening a spreadsheet.

features.title: Any mode
features.description: Bus, rail and truck routes live in the same register.

features.title: One record each
features.description: Add a route in four fields and it is available to everyone.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.description: Use your Google account — no new password.

steps.title: Register a route
steps.description: Name it, pick the mode and its length.

steps.title: Share the map
steps.description: Everyone on the team sees the same register.

items.question: Do I need to install anything?
items.answer: No. It runs in the browser on your phone or computer.

items.question: Who sees my routes?
items.answer: Only you — every account has its own register.

items.question: Can I change a route later?
items.answer: Yes. Open it from the list and edit any field.

dashboard.title: Fleet overview
dashboard.intro: Your registered routes at a glance.

cta.label: Start tracking
cta.title: Your routes, one register
cta.subtitle: Sign in and add the first route in under a minute.

contactForm.heading: Talk to us
contactForm.intro: Questions about fleets of any size are welcome.

listings.heading: What is on offer
listings.intro: Offers as cards: filter by kind, open them on the map and ask about one in a single click.
listings.notice: These offers are illustrative examples, not a live offer.

offer-1.title: Three-room flat near the centre
offer-1.summary: A bright flat on the fourth floor with a balcony and a cellar.

offer-2.title: Family house with a garden
offer-2.summary: A detached house on a quiet street, ten minutes from the centre.

offer-3.title: Office floor for a small team
offer-3.summary: An open-plan office with two meeting rooms, ready to move in.

sk.description: Všetky patterny naraz, v dvoch jazykoch: landing, prihlásenie cez Google, prehľad, tabuľka záznamov a mapa.

landing.headline: Vedzte, kde je ktoré vozidlo
landing.subheadline: Zapíšte trasy raz a uvidíte ich na mape, ktorú zdieľa celý tím.

features.title: Trasy na mape
features.description: Pozrite si každú zapísanú trasu bez otvárania tabuľky.

features.title: Ľubovoľný typ
features.description: Autobusové, železničné aj kamiónové trasy v jednom registri.

features.title: Jeden záznam na trasu
features.description: Pridajte trasu v štyroch poliach a majú ju všetci.

steps.title: Zapíšte trasu
steps.description: Pomenujte ju, vyberte typ a dĺžku.

steps.title: Zdieľajte mapu
steps.description: Celý tím vidí ten istý register.

items.question: Musím niečo inštalovať?
items.answer: Nie. Beží v prehliadači na mobile aj počítači.

items.question: Kto vidí moje trasy?
items.answer: Len vy — každý účet má vlastný register.

items.question: Dá sa trasa neskôr zmeniť?
items.answer: Áno. Otvorte ju v zozname a upravte ľubovoľné pole.

dashboard.title: Prehľad flotily
dashboard.intro: Vaše zapísané trasy na jeden pohľad.

cta.label: Začať sledovať
cta.title: Vaše trasy v jednom registri
cta.subtitle: Prihláste sa a prvú trasu pridáte za minútu.

contactForm.heading: Napíšte nám
contactForm.intro: Radi odpovieme na otázky o flotilách každej veľkosti.

listings.heading: Čo ponúkame
listings.intro: Ponuky ako karty: filtrujte podľa druhu, otvorte ich na mape a na ktorúkoľvek sa opýtajte jedným klikom.
listings.notice: Tieto ponuky sú ilustračné príklady, nie živá ponuka.

offer-1.title: Trojizbový byt blízko centra
offer-1.summary: Svetlý byt na štvrtom poschodí s balkónom a pivnicou.

offer-2.title: Rodinný dom so záhradou
offer-2.summary: Samostatný dom v tichej ulici, desať minút od centra.

offer-3.title: Kancelária pre malý tím
offer-3.summary: Otvorená kancelária s dvoma zasadačkami, pripravená na nasťahovanie.
